comments.value: Instead of a massive list it might be better to have a folder system as scrolling past a couple hundred avatars could still be slow to find something. If anything the avatar menu is broken at the moment as it crashes constantly so we should hope that gets fixed first before any quality of life comes out.
To make it even more confusing, hell no.
